news.headline: uniQure Announces Submission of Biologics License Application for Ifezuntirgene Inilparvovec (AMT-130) in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: ClearPoint's biopharma partner uniQure submitted a BLA to the FDA (requesting priority review) and a UK MAA for AMT-130, based on 3-year Phase I/II data showing slowed Huntington's disease progression; the therapy is administered via MRI-guided, convection-enhanced delivery using ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula. CLPT shares traded only modestly higher on the news since the filing had already been guided for Q3 2026 at ClearPoint's August earnings call.

news.headline: Analysts Cut ClearPoint Neuro Price Targets After Q2 Miss
news.summary: Lake Street cut its price target to $25 from $30 and Stifel cut its target to $22 from $25 following ClearPoint's Q2 miss and lowered 2026 guidance, pulling the average analyst target down to roughly $23.50 from $28. The downgrades reflect lower modeled near-term revenue growth as management redirects spending toward CAL, robotics and regulatory readiness.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
news.summary: ClearPoint reported Q2 2026 revenue of $10.9 million (+18% YoY, including the acquired IRRAflow portfolio) but missed the roughly $12.7 million consensus estimate, and cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $48-52 million from a prior $52-56 million range; shares fell over 15% in after-hours trading. Biologics and drug delivery revenue fell 15% on a non-repeating prior-year order, while neurosurgery navigation and therapy revenue grew 62%, and cash fell to $29.4 million from $45.9 million at year-end 2025.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Unveils $500 Million Long-Term Revenue Roadmap
news.summary: Alongside Q2 results, ClearPoint's investor presentation laid out a five-pillar strategy - adding robotics, focused ultrasound and its new CAL preclinical services business to its existing navigation, biologics-delivery and capital-equipment lines - as a path to $500 million in annual revenue longer-term. Management cautioned that most biopharma-partner commercial launches, and the bulk of CAL revenue, are not expected until 2027 and beyond.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Congratulates Partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA RMAT Designation for Sasineprocel
news.summary: The FDA granted Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation to Aspen Neuroscience's sasineprocel (ANPD001), an autologous cell therapy for Parkinson's disease delivered using ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula in the ASPIRO trial. RMAT status gives Aspen more frequent FDA interaction and a potential path to accelerated approval, validating ClearPoint's delivery platform with another of its 60+ biopharma partners.

news.headline: EpilepsyGTx Partners With ClearPoint Neuro to Support Targeted Delivery of Lead Gene Therapy in Epilepsy
news.summary: EpilepsyGTx selected ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and Neuro Navigation System to deliver its investigational gene therapy EPY201 in an upcoming first-in-human Phase I/IIa trial for drug-resistant focal refractory epilepsy. The deal adds another indication and biopharma partner to ClearPoint's expanding gene-therapy delivery ecosystem.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 4-year Phase I/II data readout
catalysts.detail: uniQure has said it intends to present a 4-year data analysis from its ongoing Phase I/II study of AMT-130 before the end of Q3 2026, updating on durability of the disease-progression benefit shown in the 3-year data that supported the BLA filed September 2. AMT-130 is delivered via ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula, so continued positive durability data reinforces the platform's commercial case.

catalysts.label: FDA decision on BLA filing acceptance for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Following uniQure's September 2, 2026 BLA submission (with a priority-review request) for AMT-130, the FDA typically issues a filing-acceptance decision within about 60 days, which would put a decision around early November 2026; acceptance for priority review would set up a ~6-month review clock toward a target action date in spring 2027.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint has historically reported Q3 results in early-to-mid November (Nov 6-7 in each of the last two years). An exact date has not yet been announced; investors will watch for progress on the 2026 guidance range of $48-52 million and early CAL/robotics traction.

catalysts.label: ClearPoint 2.2 navigation software full commercial launch
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint 2.2, which integrates the new Maestro Brain Model, completed FDA-cleared first clinical cases earlier in 2026 and is expected to reach full market release in the second half of 2026, supporting broader adoption across the installed base.

catalysts.label: Active site count to surpass 200
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint had more than 175 active sites as of mid-2026 and has targeted surpassing 200 active installed sites by year-end 2026, partly via its subscription-based Pathfinder program that lowers the adoption barrier for hospitals.

catalysts.label: EpilepsyGTx EPY201 first-in-human dosing
catalysts.detail: Following the July 2026 partnership announcement, EpilepsyGTx's Phase I/IIa trial of gene therapy EPY201 for focal refractory epilepsy is expected to begin first-in-human dosing using ClearPoint's delivery platform, adding a new clinical program to ClearPoint's biopharma pipeline.

catalysts.label: First GLP services contract completed at CAL
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint signed its first statement of work for GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) preclinical services at its newly acquired 30,000 sq ft ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL) facility in Torrey Pines, CA, with completion expected in the first half of 2027, which management expects to return the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment to growth.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA action date on AMT-130 BLA (if priority review granted)
catalysts.detail: If the FDA accepts uniQure's AMT-130 BLA for priority review, industry estimates point to a target action date around late April to early May 2027; an approval would mark ClearPoint's first at-scale commercial (post-trial) drug-delivery revenue stream from a biopharma partner.

catalysts.label: Robotic platform (Harmony) commercial rollout
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint's in-development robotic surgical platform, run on its Harmony 1.0 software, continues to receive neurosurgeon feedback and is one of the five pillars of the company's long-term growth strategy; a commercial launch is expected to follow further development and regulatory clearance, targeted beyond 2026.

catalysts.label: Q4 / full-year 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Based on prior-year timing (late February), ClearPoint is expected to report Q4 and full-year 2026 results in February 2027, providing the first full read on whether the revised $48-52 million 2026 guidance was met and initial 2027 guidance.

pulse: CLPT trades around $14, still roughly half its 2026 high near $30, after an August 3 Q2 miss and guidance cut to $48-52 million drove a sharp sell-off and price-target trims from Lake Street and Stifel. The dominant recent catalyst - partner uniQure's September 2 BLA and UK MAA submission for AMT-130 (delivered via ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula) - drew only a muted stock reaction since the filing had already been guided at Q2 earnings, with the next real tests being uniQure's 4-year data readout expected by end of September and an FDA filing-acceptance decision around early November. Longer term, the story remains built on ClearPoint's role as delivery platform for 60+ gene/cell-therapy partners and management's newly unveiled $500 million revenue roadmap, but near-term growth has paused as spending shifts toward the new CAL preclinical facility, robotics and regulatory readiness, with cash down to $29.4 million at Q2-end keeping dilution risk on investors' minds ahead of Q3 results expected in November.
